operations.value: desktop/scripts/check-shell.js parses every file and pairs preload.js's channels with main.js, but it never loads src/preload/board.js and does not pair board.js's ipcRenderer.on channels with main.js's webContents.send calls. On the keyboard-shortcuts branch a relative require in board.js made the preload fail to load under Electron's default sandbox — taking the board's theme handshake (theme:current, board:scheme, board:align) with it — and every check stayed green; only a manual smoke run found it. The branch resolved it by inlining the helper under marker comments with a drift check, keeping the sandbox on. Remaining follow-up: (a) a check that loads board.js in a plain Node context with stubbed electron/document/history to prove it evaluates; (b) pair board.js's ipcRenderer.on channels with main.js's webContents.send calls the way preload.js's are paired.
